○ Match ':'.

member.name: M:Meziantou.Framework.DependencyScanning.Scanners.PythonRequirementsDependencyScanner.PypiReferenceRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^(?<PACKAGENAME>[\\w\\.-]+?)\\s?(\\[.*\\])?\\s?==\\s?(?<VERSION>[\\w\\.-]*?)$
Options:
RegexOptions.ExplicitCapture | RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.Singleline | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ "PACKAGENAME" capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [\-.\w] lazily at least once.
○ Match a whitespace character greedily, optionally.
○ Optional (greedy).
○ Match '['.
○ Match any character greedily any number of times.
○ Match ']'.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically, optionally.
○ Match the string "==".
○ Match a whitespace character greedily, optionally.
○ "VERSION" capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [\-.\w] atomically any number of times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
